title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Genesis 15: Yahweh's promise of offspring, Abram's faith and the covenant between the pieces.

questions.text: In the vision, what did Yahweh say He was to Abram, along with his exceedingly great reward?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Don't be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward."

questions.text: Who did Abram say would inherit his estate, since he was childless?
questions.explanation: Abram said he went childless and that he who would inherit his estate was Eliezer of Damascus.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Abram to look at and count?
questions.explanation: Yahweh brought him outside and said, "Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them... So your offspring will be."

questions.text: What did Yahweh credit to Abram for righteousness?
questions.explanation: Abram believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.

answers.text: That he gave a tenth of all
That he left his father's house

questions.text: Out of which place did Yahweh say He had brought Abram?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it."

questions.text: How old were the heifer, the female goat and the ram that Abram had to bring?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asked for a heifer, a female goat and a ram, each three years old, plus a turtledove and a young pigeon.

questions.text: What fell on Abram when the sun was going down?
questions.explanation: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram, and terror and great darkness fell on him.

questions.text: For how long would Abram's offspring be afflicted in a land that was not theirs?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said Abram's offspring would live as foreigners in a land not theirs, would serve them, and would be afflicted four hundred years.

questions.text: What passed between the pieces when it was dark?
questions.explanation: When the sun went down and it was dark, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between the pieces.

answers.text: A smoking furnace and a flaming torch
A pillar of cloud and fire
An angel holding a flaming sword
A white dove carrying a branch

questions.text: Which river did Yahweh call "the great river" when describing the land given to Abram's offspring?
questions.explanation: Yahweh gave the land from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates.
